2607.21291.title: Adaptive Depth Sparse Framework: Similarity-Driven Resource Allocation for Pre-Trained LLMs
2607.21291.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong generation and reasoning performance, but the Transformer architecture incurs high inference cost. Existing acceleration methods often rely on task-specific fine-tuning or training from scratch, increasing adaptation cost and limiting cross-task usability. We present an Adaptive Depth Sparse Framework (AdaDSF) that converts off-the-shelf pre-trained LLMs into depth-sparse models without full retraining. Our key insight is that layers contribute unequally to representation transformation, characterized by the cosine similarity between layer input and output hidden states. Based on this, AdaDSF assigns layer-wise token retention ratios from similarity statistics, uses a lightweight router to select informative tokens at each layer, and introduces a feature-preserving alignment objective to match intermediate and final representations between sparse and dense models. On GPT-NeoX and Qwen2.5 over language modeling and commonsense reasoning, AdaDSF substantially reduces inference FLOPs while preserving performance close to dense counterparts. Under comparable sparsity, AdaDSF consistently yields smaller accuracy degradation than strong baselines including MoD, D-LLM, and DLO.
2607.21291.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在生成和推理性能上表現優異，但Transformer架構的推理成本較高。現有的加速方法通常依賴於特定任務的微調或從頭訓練，這增加了適應成本並限制了跨任務的可用性。我們提出了一個自適應深度稀疏框架（AdaDSF），該框架能在不進行全面重訓練的情況下將現成的預訓練LLMs轉換為深度稀疏模型。我們的關鍵見解是，各層對表示轉換的貢獻不均，這一特徵由層輸入和輸出隱藏狀態之間的餘弦相似度來表徵。基於此，AdaDSF根據相似性統計分配層級的標記保留比例，使用輕量級路由器在每層選擇信息豐富的標記，並引入一個特徵保留對齊目標，以匹配稀疏模型和密集模型之間的中間和最終表示。在語言建模和常識推理的GPT-NeoX和Qwen2.5上，AdaDSF顯著減少了推理FLOPs，同時保持接近密集模型的性能。在可比的稀疏度下，AdaDSF始終產生比包括MoD、D-LLM和DLO等強基準更小的準確度下降。
